facts.fact: Watu Credit Uganda, a two- and three-wheeler asset-finance company, raised a USD 15m five-year debt facility in January 2024 from Gateway Partners through Alpen Capital's Africa Credit Opportunities Fund, the first tranche of a USD 50m mandate; the document does not say where the financier is from.
Ugandan e-bike start-up Gogo Electric raised USD 1.6m from the EU-backed Electrification Financing Initiative (ElectriFI); the document lists it among 2024 raises and gives no month.
Rexial, a Ugandan direct-debit payments start-up, raised a USD 420,000 seed round in September 2024; the document does not name the investors.

note: Deal-level facts for three named raises; the USD 19m 2024 total and undisclosed rounds (eMaisha Pay, Power Up, Level Africa) have no amount per deal.
